skill_name: Create a story of a child who is afraid of the dark
workflow: Once upon a time, there was a child named Lila who was afraid of the dark. No matter how much her parents tried to encourage her, she still couldn't get past her fear of the dark. She would beg her parents to keep her bedroom door open when she slept, but they knew that was not a suitable solution. In an attempt to help Lila confront her fear, they took her camping and showed her the beauty of the night sky, the gentle light of the stars, and the peacefulness of the darkness.
